name: io.github.tomwellnitz/fritzos8-mcp
title: FRITZ!OS 8
description: FRITZ!Box on FRITZ!OS 8: diagnostics, security audit, devices, Wi-Fi, phone, smart home

environmentVariables.name: FRITZ_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host name or IP of the FRITZ!Box (default fritz.box)

environmentVariables.name: FRITZ_USER
environmentVariables.description: FRITZ!Box user for the server (dedicated user recommended)

environmentVariables.name: FRITZ_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of that user (alternatively FRITZ_PASSWORD_FILE or the OS keychain)

environmentVariables.name: FRITZ_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable write tools (every write is read back)
